After a fun day together, the three of you go to the beach to relax and talk a bit more...
\f[facedad]\b...It’s funny.
\f[facedad]\bSince you were little... I've missed so many days like this because I was working so much...
\f[facemom]\rBut when they happened... you loved them.
\f[facemom]\rYou both would be smiling the whole day.
\f[facedad]\bYeah.
\f[facedad]\bYou think there will always be time. Another weekend. Another trip. Another summer.
\f[facemom]\rAnd then one day... you blink.

then.text: \f[facemom]\rAnd your little boy is taller, stronger... and traveling the world on his own.

else.text: \f[facemom]\rAnd your little girl is all grown up... and traveling the world on her own.

list.text: \f[facedad]\bI can still remember you running around the house like a little Mankey.\nCouldn't sit still for five minutes.
\f[facemom]\rThat part hasn't change! Haha
\f[facemom]\rWhat? It's true.\nYou just run around bigger places now.
\f[facedad]\bI've been working so much for so many years...\nI keep saying, "I'll rest later".
\f[facedad]\bAfter this project.\nAfter this busy season.\nAfter one more month.
\f[facedad]\bBut later keeps moving...
\f[facemom]\rThat's why this trip matters.
\f[facemom]\rNot because it's fancy or far away...
\f[facemom]\rBut because we're here. Together.
\f[facedad]\b...Yeah. I'm glad we came.
\f[facedad]\bTo be honest...\nSeeing you out here, doing your own thing... it makes me proud.
\f[facedad]\bNot just because you're strong.
\f[facedad]\bBecause you grew up kind.
\f[facedad]\bBut I still ask myself, when did you start looking so grown up? I feel like I missed a lot.
\f[facemom]\rDon't feel like that honey, you did what had to be done to keep our family afloat.
\f[facedad]\bYou know...\nNo matter how far you go, or how much things change...
\f[facemom]\rYes, always.
